objectives.description: Write research_questions to state.json with overwrite-on-write semantics
Extend skill_postflight_update() whitelist and add needs_research case arm with research_questions forwarding
Decide and record monotonic-max clamp interaction for needs_research
objectives.note: Decision: needs_research is deliberately absent from STATUS_VOCABULARY_LIFECYCLE_RANK, so status_vocabulary_would_regress always returns 'no regression' for it -- the clamp can never skip a needs_research write, by construction. Confirmed by fixture test with current status='planning' (rank 3) and clamp_mode=monotonic-max: write proceeded to 'researching'.

deviations.description: Add research_questions property to context/schemas/state-schema.json's active_projects entry (additionalProperties: false)
deviations.reason: Not named in the plan's Phase 2 task list or Files to modify, but required for correctness: state-schema.json enforces additionalProperties: false on the active_projects entry shape and already lists file_scope explicitly as a sibling documented-optional field. Without this addition, any task carrying research_questions would fail validate-state.sh --deep schema validation. Scope expansion recorded per Phase 1's own precedent (a hit not on the plan's list is recorded, not silently absorbed).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — also added research_questions to context/schemas/state-schema.json, required by its additionalProperties: false enforcement, not named in the plan's file list)*
